description:
You are a product visualization specialist. A BMW car model is loaded in Blender but has no lighting — all lights have been removed. Your job is to set up professional studio lighting for a product photography shot.

Requirements:
1. Create a 3-point lighting setup with at least 3 lights (use Area or Spot lights for studio quality)
2. Position the camera for a classic automotive 3/4 front view
3. Set the world/environment background to a dark studio color (near black)
4. Render the final image and save it to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/product_shot.png'
5. Save the Blender project file to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/studio_setup.blend'

Login: The desktop session is already active. Blender is open with the car model loaded.
